columns.name: CONTEST_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key of the table.

columns.name: SOURCE_ID
columns.description: This column used to store the id of communication source.

columns.name: CONVERSATION_ID
columns.description: This column used to store the id of conversation.

columns.name: IS_TIES_ALLOWED
columns.description: This column indicated whether ties allowd or not for corresponding competition

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: This is the name of the contest.

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the start of the corresponding contest.

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the end date of the corresponding contest.

columns.name: CORPORATE_FLAG
columns.description: This column indicates if a contest is a coporate contest rather than a regular contest.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: This is the description of the contest.

columns.name: PARTICIPANT_TYPE
columns.description: Determines what type participants are allowed to participate in the contest.

columns.name: IMAGE_URI
columns.description: This column stores the image URI for the current contest.

columns.name: PARTICIPATION_RATE_TARGET
columns.description: The column stores the target participation rate.

columns.name: REWARD_ID
columns.description: This column is a FK to HWR_CNST_REWARD_B  table. (OBSOLETE)

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
